## Stage 2 - Research

{
  "findings": "The codebase has no literal 'surface-setup-check' concept. Each check can fail independently; their outputs are combined via BuildCombinedFailure in RelayDriver.FailureOutput.cs into a structured format. The existing diagnostics architecture is already sophisticated: output distillation (ProcessRunners.Diagnostics.cs) filters nono noise and extracts failure markers; ErrorHintClassifier.cs maps failure signatures to actionable hints; PublishVerifyResultAsync persists full output to stageN-attemptM.verify-output.txt artifacts and emits structured verify_result events; the fix-verify loop (RelayDriver.VerifyFix.cs) re-executes with tier escalation on red; FlaggedWorkStore captures the working tree for resume. All this lives in ~15 partial files of RelayDriver across src/VisualRelay.Core/Execution/. The key entry point is RunStage10PreAgentAsync in RelayDriver.Stage9.cs, which orchestrates the three checks and returns a Stage10PreAgentData record with all results.",

{
  "evidence": "The codebase captures rich structured data about each surface-setup-check sub-result (bootstrap, guard, new-guard-probe, test) in the Stage10PreAgentData record (RelayDriver.Stage9.cs lines 9-17), but this structure is immediately flattened into combined plain text via BuildCombinedFailure (RelayDriver.FailureOutput.cs lines 54-76). Neither the verify_result observability event (RelayDriver.VerifyObservability.cs lines 45-56), the NEEDS-REVIEW marker (RelayDriver.Events.cs lines 101-118), the flagged event (RelayDriver.Events.cs lines 119-121), nor the verify-output.txt artifact header (RelayDriver.VerifyObservability.cs lines 77-79) preserve the per-check structured breakdown. The verify_result event always reports config.TestCommand as the 'command' (line 50) regardless of which sub-check actually failed, and the 'reason' field carries only the distilled test failure reason (line 33-35), which is empty when the test command passed but bootstrap/guard failed. A downstream consumer — human or tool — must parse free-form text to determine which setup precondition broke. The same gap persists in the fix-verify loop (RelayDriver.VerifyFix.cs lines 162-179), where bootstrap and guard re-checks feed into the same combined text path without emitting per-check structured events. No dedicated artifact captures a structured JSON breakdown of the three setup checks (bootstrap status/command/output, guard status/command/output, new-guard-probe status/output).",

    "RelayDriver.FailureOutput.cs:54-76 — BuildCombinedFailure: joins test failure text, guard output, new-guard-probe output, and bootstrap failure output into a single flat string joined by '\\n\\n', losing the identity of which section came from which check.",

The 'command' is always config.TestCommand (line 50), never the bootstrap or guard command. The 'reason' is ExtractFailureReason(testResult.Output) which is empty when the test passed. No field indicates bootstrap/guard/new-guard status.",
    "RelayDriver.VerifyObservability.cs:70-88 — TryPersistVerifyOutput: the artifact header only carries 'check' and 'capturedUtc', with no per-sub-check status breakdown.",
    "RelayDriver.Events.cs:93-136 — FlagAsync: the NEEDS-REVIEW marker body is '{reason}\\nstage {stageNumber}\\n{details}' where details is the combined failure text; the flagged event Data has only {reason}. No structured sub-check breakdown.",
    "RelayDriver.VerifyFix.cs:116-179 — fix-verify loop: bootstrap and guard re-checks feed into BuildFullFailureOutput/BuildFailureOutput; the per-iteration verify_result event carries the same flat fields as stage 10. No per-sub-check structured event is emitted at any point.",
    "RelayDriver.cs:130-145 — main driver stage-10 block: destructures Stage10PreAgentData into locals; uses them only to compute stage10Red (line 228-229) and feed combined failure outputs. The structured per-check data is not written to any artifact."

  "repro": "1. Configure a relay task in a repo with a flake.nix (triggers auto-detected bootstrap check).\n2. Break the nix environment so `nix develop --command true` fails, or set BootstrapCheckCommand to a failing command in .relay/config.json.\n3. Run the task. At stage 10, the bootstrap check will fail.\n4. Observe the verify_result event: 'command' shows the test command (not the bootstrap command), 'reason' is empty (since the test didn't run/fail), 'check' is 'red'. The event gives no indication that bootstrap — not the test suite or guard — is the failure source.\n5. Observe the NEEDS-REVIEW file: it contains combined failure text with a '--- Bootstrap check output ---' section — but this is free-form text requiring manual parsing.\n6. Alternatively, trigger a guard failure (e.g. file exceeding the size limit): the verify_result event is equally opaque about which check failed.\n7. In any case, there is no machine-parseable artifact that says: bootstrap=red, guard=green, new-guard-probe=green, test=green — the per-check breakdown exists only transiently in the Stage10PreAgentData record and is never persisted."

Now I have full context. Let me compose the plan.

```json
{
  "plan": "## Summary

Persist a structured per-check JSON artifact (`stageN-attemptM.verify-checks.json`) alongside the existing verify-output.txt, and augment the `verify_result` observability event with per-sub-check fields (`bootstrapCheck`, `guardCheck`, `newGuardProbeCheck`, `testCheck`). No changes to pipeline stages, relay config schema, or the NEEDS-REVIEW marker contract — purely additive observability.

---

## 1. New file: `RelayDriver.SetupChecks.cs` (~115 lines)

**Purpose:** Houses the `SetupCheckResults` record and its factories/serializers. A new partial of `RelayDriver` following the existing pattern.

**Contents:**
- `internal sealed record SetupCheckResults` with 10 properties:
  - `BootstrapCheck` (`string?` — `"green"`, `"red"`, or `null` for skipped)
  - `BootstrapCommand` (`string?`)
  - `BootstrapOutput` (`string?` — only on failure)
  - `GuardCheck` (`string?`)
  - `GuardOutput` (`string?`)
  - `NewGuardProbeCheck` (`string?` — `"red"` or `null`; green/skipped both null since probe only has a failure path)
  - `NewGuardProbeOutput` (`string?`)
  - `TestCheck` (`string?` — `"green"` or `"red"`)
  - `TestCommand` (`string`)
  - `TestExitCode` (`int?`)

- `static FromPreAgentData(Stage10PreAgentData data, RelayConfig config)` — builds from stage-10 pre-agent gate result. GuardCheck uses `config.GuardCommand` to decide skipped vs present; BootstrapCheck uses `data.BootstrapCmd`.

- `static FromFixVerifyIteration(TestRunResult? bootstrapResult, string? bootstrapCmd, string? guardOutput, string? guardCmd, TestRunResult testResult, string testCommand)` — builds from fix-verify loop iteration data. NewGuardProbe is always null (not re-run in the loop). BootstrapCheck/GuardCheck are green when the command ran and passed, red when it produced a failing result, null when the command wasn't configured.

- `ToEventData() → Dictionary<string, string>` — emits only non-null check fields keyed as `bootstrapCheck`, `bootstrapCommand`, `guardCheck`, `newGuardProbeCheck`, `testCheck`. Intended for merging into `RelayEvent.Data`.

- `ToSummaryLines() → string` — human-readable summary with ✓/✗/— icons, e.g.:
  ```
  --- Setup check breakdown ---
  ✓ bootstrap: green
  ✗ guard: red
  — new-guard-probe: skipped
  ✓ test: green
  ```

- `bool IsAnyRed()` — true when any sub-check (other than test) is `"red"`.

---

## 2. Modify: `RelayDriver.VerifyObservability.cs` (~89 → ~125 lines)

**`PublishVerifyResultAsync` — new parameter and augmented event:**
- Add parameter `SetupCheckResults? setupChecks = null` at the end of the signature.
- When `setupChecks` is non-null, merge `setupChecks.ToEventData()` entries into the `Data` dictionary passed to `RelayEvent`.
- When `setupChecks` is non-null, call `TryPersistVerifyChecksJson` (best-effort, fire-and-forget, same pattern as `TryPersistVerifyOutput`).
- Fix the `reason` computation: when `testResult.ExitCode == 0` but `setupChecks?.IsAnyRed() == true`, set `reason = "setup check failure"` instead of `string.Empty`. This closes the gap where bootstrap/guard failure left the `verify_result` event with an empty reason.

**New method: `TryPersistVerifyChecksJson`:**
- Internal static, mirrors `TryPersistVerifyOutput`.
- Writes `stage{N}-attempt{M}.verify-checks.json` under `taskDirectory` as indented camelCase JSON via `System.Text.Json`.
- Returns absolute path (or null on failure).
- Needs `using System.Text.Json;` added at top of file.

---

## 3. Modify: `RelayDriver.cs` (300 lines → stays at 300)

**Goal:** Capture the `Stage10PreAgentData` record so structured results can be passed downstream, without adding net lines.

**Changes:**
- Line ~50–51: Combine `var reviewPairHandled = false;` and `var reviewFamilyClean = false;` into one line → saves 1 line.
- Line ~96: Remove blank line between `continue;` and closing `}` → saves 1 line.
- After line ~129 (`string? stage10GuardOutput = null;`): Add `Stage10PreAgentData? stage10PreAgentData = null;` → +1 line.
- Inside the `if (stage.Number == 10)` block, after the destructuring assigns all locals: Add `stage10PreAgentData = d;` → +1 line.
- Line ~234: Modify `PublishVerifyResultAsync` call to add `setupChecks: SetupCheckResults.FromPreAgentData(stage10PreAgentData, config)` → same line count (longer line).
- Line ~258: Modify `FlagAsync` call so the `details` argument prepends `SetupCheckResults.FromPreAgentData(stage10PreAgentData, config).ToSummaryLines() + "\n\n"` to `failingTestOutput` inline → same line count (longer line).

Net: 300 → 300.

---

## 4. Modify: `RelayDriver.VerifyFix.cs` (~244 → ~260 lines)

**Goal:** Persist per-iteration setup-check JSON and emit structured check status in each fix-verify iteration's `verify_result` event.

**Changes:**
- After line ~172 (after bootstrap/guard re-check and test run complete, before `PublishVerifyResultAsync` call): Build `attemptSetupChecks` from the iteration's local variables:
  ```csharp
  var attemptSetupChecks = SetupCheckResults.FromFixVerifyIteration(
      bootstrapFailingResult, bootstrapCheckCmd,
      guardFailureOutput, guardCmd,
      testResult, config.TestCommand);
  ```
  → +3 lines.
- Modify `PublishVerifyResultAsync` call at line ~180 to add `setupChecks: attemptSetupChecks` → same line count.
- At the final exhaustion `FlagAsync` call (line ~220–221), prepend `attemptSetupChecks.ToSummaryLines() + "\n\n"` to `failingTestOutput` → +2 lines (the existing `FlagAsync` line is replaced with a `var flagDetails = ...` + inline `FlagAsync` call).

---

## 5. New test file: `tests/VisualRelay.Tests/SetupCheckResultsTests.cs` (~80 lines)

**Purpose:** Unit-test the `SetupCheckResults` factories and serialization methods.

**Test methods:**
- `FromPreAgentData_AllGreen` — all checks pass → every Check field is `"green"`.
- `FromPreAgentData_BootstrapFailed` — bootstrap failed, others green → `BootstrapCheck == "red"`, `TestCheck == "green"`.
- `FromPreAgentData_GuardFailed` — guard failed → `GuardCheck == "red"`, `BootstrapCheck == "green"`.
- `FromPreAgentData_BootstrapAndGuardSkipped` — no bootstrap cmd, no guard cmd → both checks null.
- `FromFixVerifyIteration_BootstrapRed` — `bootstrapResult` non-null → `BootstrapCheck == "red"`.
- `ToEventData_OmitsNullChecks` — skipped checks excluded from dictionary.
- `ToSummaryLines_FormatsCorrectly` — verified output structure.
- `IsAnyRed_TrueWhenBootstrapOrGuardRed` — truth table.

---

## Artifact contract

New artifact: `.relay/{taskId}/stage{N}-attempt{M}.verify-checks.json`

```json
{
  "bootstrapCheck": "green",
  "bootstrapCommand": "nix develop --command true",
  "guardCheck": "red",
  "guardOutput": "file too large: src/Foo.cs has 345 lines (limit 300)",
  "newGuardProbeCheck": null,
  "testCheck": "green",
  "testCommand": "dotnet test",
  "testExitCode": 0
}
```

Augmented `verify_result` event Data gains: `bootstrapCheck`, `bootstrapCommand`, `guardCheck`, `newGuardProbeCheck`, `testCheck` — only when non-null. The existing `command`, `exitCode`, `check`, `reason`, `treeHash`, `outputFile` fields are unchanged.

## Constraints satisfied

- **300-line limit:** All modified files stay under 300. New files are ~115 and ~80 lines.
- **Partial-class pattern:** New `SetupCheckResults` is an `internal sealed record` inside a new partial of `RelayDriver`.
- **nono sandbox:** Artifact writes go to `.relay/{taskId}/` which is within the allow-list.
- **Artifact naming convention:** `stage{N}-attempt{M}.verify-checks.json` follows the established `stage{N}-attempt{M}.verify-output.txt` pattern.
- **NEEDS-REVIEW marker:** Not broken — the marker body still contains the combined failure text; the addition is a human-readable summary prepended within the existing `details` field.
- **12-stage pipeline:** No new stage. Stage 10 and 11 are enhanced, not restructured.
- **Null handling:** Bootstrap and guard are opt-in via config; absent checks produce `null` in the record and are omitted from the event data.
- **BaselineVerify:** Unchanged — the setup-check JSON does not affect baseline diffing.
- **BannedApiAnalyzers / test constraints:** No `HeadlessUnitTestSession`; test file is a plain xUnit test class.",
  "manifest": [
    "+src/VisualRelay.Core/Execution/RelayDriver.SetupChecks.cs",
    "src/VisualRelay.Core/Execution/RelayDriver.VerifyObservability.cs",
    "src/VisualRelay.Core/Execution/RelayDriver.cs",
    "src/VisualRelay.Core/Execution/RelayDriver.VerifyFix.cs",
    "+tests/VisualRelay.Tests/SetupCheckResultsTests.cs"
  ]
}
```
